name: Webcrome Neon Sign Customizer for WooCommerce
author: Webcrome Software

sections.description:
Webcrome Neon Sign Customizer lets your customers design custom neon signs with a live glowing preview directly on your WooCommerce product page.

No coding required. Install, enable on any product, and your customers can design their sign in seconds.

Free Features

  • Real-time neon glow preview with authentic flicker animation
  • 6 neon colors with true glow effect
  • 4 Google Fonts with live preview
  • Dynamic pricing — price updates live as customer types
  • WooCommerce cart integration — design details saved to order
  • Mobile responsive

Pro Features

Upgrade to SignGlow Pro at webcrome.com for:

  • SVG export — production-ready vector file for your sign manufacturer
  • Multi-line text — up to 4 lines with live preview
  • Logo / image upload — customer uploads their own logo
  • Quote mode — customers request a quote, you get full specs by email
  • AI Design Assistant — suggests best font, color and material
  • 10 neon colors + 8 Google Fonts
  • 3 sign materials — Neon/LED, Channel Letters, Acrylic
  • 4 backboard options with individual pricing
  • Size presets + custom width and height sliders
  • ON / OFF toggle to preview sign when switched off
  • Jacket and mounting options
  • Full admin panel — manage all colors, fonts, materials and pricing
  • Manufacturer email — auto-sends full production specs on every order

Get SignGlow Pro — $43/year

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8+
  • WooCommerce 5.0+
  • PHP 7.4+

Setup in 3 Steps

  1. Install and activate
  2. Edit any WooCommerce product → check Enable Neon Sign Customizer → save
  3. Visit product page — customizer appears automatically
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin
  2. Make sure WooCommerce is active
  3. Edit any product → check Enable Neon Sign Customizer → save
  4. Visit product page — customizer appears
sections.faq:
Does this work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes — compatible with Storefront, Astra, OceanWP, Flatsome, Divi and all WooCommerce themes.

Can I change the currency?

Yes — go to Neon Sign Customizer → Settings → Currency Symbol.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Visit webcrome.com to purchase SignGlow Pro. After payment you will receive a license key by email. Install the Pro plugin and enter your key to unlock all features.

What is SVG export?

SVG export (Pro feature) generates a production-ready vector file of the customer’s sign design that you send directly to your sign manufacturer.

Can customers request a quote instead of buying directly?

Yes — Quote mode is available in the Pro version. Visit webcrome.com to upgrade.
